title: SpaceX closes $60 billion acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor
reason: Published. Full multi-agent protocol run (fresh verifier + fresh adversarial falsifier, parallel, neither saw the other's work). Core facts confirmed via a SpaceX SEC 8-K filing (Tier 0 regulatory document) plus Cursor's own blog post and independent June-2026 reporting (CNBC, Forbes, TechCrunch) on the original deal terms. Falsifier caught and corrected two errors present in same-day press coverage: (1) the close date widely reported as 15 August is actually 14 August per the filing and Cursor's own dated post -- 15 August coverage is next-day pickup; (2) 'SpaceXAI' (SpaceX's internal AI-products brand from its Feb-2026 xAI merger) is not the acquiring legal entity -- plain 'SpaceX' is, per every primary source, so the article does not call SpaceXAI the acquirer. A 'second-largest venture-backed acquisition ever' superlative circulating in press coverage was dropped as inconsistent/unverifiable (June coverage called the same deal 'largest'). Cursor's own revenue and customer-count figures were checked and found inconsistent across secondary aggregators (analyst estimates, not independently confirmed) -- omitted rather than published as fact.
